column1: # 2x2 sweep: --heat on/off X --bypass on/off, defaults elsewhere.
# --heat: maintain a global per-variable counter, incremented at each
#   probe-end for variables true in that probe's best. New fresh-random
#   picks set each variable to true with probability heat[v]/probes.
# --bypass: at each cutoff, extend the probe with probability p^c,
#   where p = fraction of past probe-bests strictly worse than current
#   stats.tmp (capped 0.99), c = # cutoff hits so far in this probe.
# Cutoff stays at the default (200K). All defaults otherwise
